reviews.review:
good work on your first game and also the story was good to,

i had a few issue I had notice was the control would lock up at time when you try to order unit around, 
also when ever you are calling the support artillery in it will deselect the unit so you have to reselect it over and over again to were it does get annoying, also some time in the fire controle mission the enemy will not spawn to were you must restart the mission to fix it
and also when ever you take conrtol of your unit cannot shoot sometimes

the tanks i think is a bit to OP when you are taking control of it with a bit to big of a blast area i could clear area easily from a far with out the ai shooting back to were mission get to easy when you get a tank
reviews.developer_response: Thank you sir for your constructive criticism ! Hopefully the issues you listed did not prevent you from enjoying the game. My future projects MUST be way smoother, more polished and overall better quality and user experience.
